clips.text: The Secretary of the Interior, Dr. Work, who has been in the West for a fortnight, returned last evening to his apartment in Wardman Park Hotel.
Ruckland. are at Wardman Park Hotel for several days.

The Minister of the Irish Free State, Dr. Timothy Smiddy, and their daughters, have been joined in their apartment at Wardman Park Hotel by Mrs. Smiddy, who spent sometime In Detroit visiting her son, Mr. Sars fleld Smiddy. returning to Washington byway of Philadelphia.
The sercretary of the Netherlands legation, Baron van Boetzelaer, will be joined by Baroness van Boetzelaer In their apartment at the Wardman Park Hotel, the latter part of the Week.
The Ambassador and his family will return on Sunday to Washington, where they sre estab lished at the Wardman Park Hotel.

note: Clips are machine-read text (OCR) from scanned Evening Star pages on the Library of Congress's Chronicling America, lightly cleaned (line-break hyphens rejoined, stray symbols removed); misspellings are the scanner's. Newspapers this old are public domain. Each clip links to its page at loc.gov. Clips that mention race, covenants, deed restrictions or slurs are skipped automatically (keyword list: race, races, racial, colored, coloured, negro, negroes, white only, whites only, for whites, white people, white persons, white residents, caucasian, segregation, segregated, covenant, covenants, restricted, restriction, restrictions, plus a list of slurs), because they need an editor's context; legal notices and lists of private individuals are skipped too.
